behavior.entryPoint: junk --tui; JunkSessionRequest.watch opt-in for API consumers

backends.macos: Persistent FSEvents stream/run-loop before traversal, pre-observation event cursor; never suppress own/delayed setup events.
backends.linux: One nonblocking inotify descriptor; watches installed against retained directory descriptors before enumeration, reused by device/inode, bounded mapping registry.
backends.windows: OpenFileById with retained volume hint; independent asynchronous root handle, identity/provider checks, ReadDirectoryChangesW subtree requests reissued before parsing the completed buffer.

behavior.changeScopes: Containing directories coalesced with ancestor subsumption; .git changes refresh repository context; ordinary no-follow scan/classifier handles newly created/deleted candidates.
behavior.racingChanges: Queue drains before revision admission; callbacks during scans remain pending for the next revision.
behavior.gaps: Overflow, native loss/unknown mapping or root identity change triggers full scan and subscriptions rebuild. Permanent failure triggers one full fallback and disables auto refresh with watch_unavailable.
behavior.rootReplacement: One-second root-only native re-admission compares object/filesystem/mount identity; does not enumerate descendants.
behavior.cancelAndMutations: Cancel pauses auto admission until manual refresh. Shared pause lease atomically excludes queued/running revisions and survives clones until native Trash/quarantine work and result reconciliation finish.
behavior.shutdown: Listeners canceled/reaped on session worker; UI never joins. OS cancellation completion may block a worker.
behavior.authority: Notification paths select fresh work only. Historical previews never become current through quiet notifications; ancestors not observed stay historical; cleanup still independently revalidates native identity.
behavior.oneShotReports: No persistent listener; ordinary full scan. No cross-process daemon or subtree cache replay qualification.
behavior.knownScopeLimitations: Independent Linux temporary-object facts and roots outside the discovered scope require full refresh; remote/mmap/delayed events and external activity/configuration cannot be certified by an empty queue.

contractsTested: Independent read_dir/symlink_metadata oracle for rewritten, deleted and new candidates; all EntryObserved callbacks prove unrelated sibling payloads not walked.
Native macOS pipeline: rewrite, synchronized second write during Base candidate observation, deletion, recreation, root rename/replacement, cancel/manual resume and listener release on close.
Queue component-aware coalescing, repository expansion, overflow and malformed input fallbacks; subsequent changes survive drains.
Gap behind an unconsumed terminal and operation pause is retained for the next revision.
Atomic pause admission rejects busy/undrained sessions; clones retain the pause lease.
CLI directory scope preserves unrelated row state.
Platform-specific inotify/Windows notification malformed/overflow/rename parser tests compiled in target lint; not run on those systems.

benchmark.phase: worker revision including rules, traversal, formats, Git, replacement and mailbox consumption
benchmark.cache: retained session candidates; no persisted SweepX cache; OS cache uncontrolled
benchmark.equivalence: all merged candidate paths and logical bytes equal independent read_dir plus symlink_metadata on every pair
benchmark.fixture: 16 projects, each Cargo.toml plus target directory containing 512 artifact files and a rewritten payload; 8208 artifact files total; one target changes between revisions
limitations: Only this macOS host/controlled workload; no Linux or Windows timing.
OS cache and concurrent host activity uncontrolled; initialized in-memory session state, no persisted SweepX cache.
Worker-revision comparison, excluding notification delivery/debounce; not end-to-end event latency.
Five alternating pairs; no p95/p99 or release performance-gate qualification.
Oracle checks candidate paths/logical bytes, not allocation, hard-link uniqueness or reclaimable space.
benchmark.filesystem: Native macOS temporary-directory fixture; filesystem/mount settings were not separately captured for this run.
